I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It's a 1280px screen inside `#component`, built from `DESIGN.md`. It has the "Notifications" heading, an ink pill "Mark All as Read" button, and the six notifications in order with the exact text and times. The first three are unread, shown with a blue tint, an accent dot and a blue timestamp. It uses static HTML and CSS only.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo are named in the font stack, but nothing is loaded because the brief allows no outside assets. Without them installed, the page falls back to Helvetica/Arial.
- **Extra elements:** I added a small icon beside each notification, plus an icon inside the button. The icons are decorative and carry no text. The unread dot has an "Unread" accessibility label.

`session.json` was empty and `session.err` held only a model-name log line, so they didn't affect the design.
